descriptions.notStarted: At The Nautilus, there's a kid who is forever curious and loves to make pranks. Bartol tells me now he has a good prank to pull on someone. If I want to join in, I better head over to the middle hallway of The Nautilus to find Bartol!
descriptions.inProgress: All #bCalico#k ever does is sleep, sleep, sleep, when what he should be doing is keeping an eye out on the crew's bedrooms. Bartol thinks it would be funny to throw an #bEvil Eye Tail#k onto Calico and see how he reacts. Might be a fun little prank, no? \n\n#i 4000007##t 4000007#  #b#c 4000007#/10#k
descriptions.completed: Calico awakes, in total shock. C'mon, Calico, you've got to stop falling asleep!
